transmitted_semantics.text: The video captures a woman in mid-stride, walking on a sidewalk. She is dressed in a black coat and black pants, with black shoes. Her hair is neatly pulled back into a bun. The sidewalk she walks on is lined with a green bush and a tree, adding a touch of nature to the urban setting. The building behind her is a beige brick structure, providing a neutral backdrop to the scene. The woman's confident stride and the simplicity of the surroundings create a sense of everyday life captured in a moment.

The video captures a woman in mid-stride on a sidewalk, her figure framed by a building on the left and a bush on the right. She is dressed in a black coat and pants, with a red scarf adding a pop of color to her outfit. The sidewalk, made of concrete, extends into the distance, leading the viewer's eye towards the woman. The building behind her is a simple structure, its beige facade contrasting with the vibrant green of the bush. The scene is devoid of any text or other objects, focusing solely on the woman and her solitary journey down the sidewalk.

visual_review.method: Manual inspection of synchronized sampled frames from the normalized source, previous HQ result, and new full run; also inspected received keyframes 179 and 239.
observations: The coarse rightward traversal followed by a return toward the center is present in the new reconstruction.
The previous HQ reconstruction did not reach the rightmost turning location in the sampled timeline.
Body appearance, gait, and turn timing differ from the original; exact action fidelity is not established.
Automatic captions still omit explicit turn/return directions; the second caption incorrectly mentions a red scarf.

limitations: An application of published LGVSC code/settings to ETRI, not the paper benchmark reproduction.
Hardware and runtime adaptations prevent a claim of bitwise equivalence.
Image quality and completed execution alone do not establish action fidelity.
Serialized complex64 bytes are not physical RF bits.
Old HQ/SGD results use a different frame count and geometry; no matched rate-quality comparison claimed.
